seeds.爱: You love a friend 友 so much you choke up 旡 — throat tight, heart full: that catch in the breath is love.
seeds.二: Two plain horizontal strokes stacked up — count them and you have the number itself.
seeds.姐: 女 woman plus 且 moreover — the woman who came first, and moreover bosses you around: your older sister. 且 qiě lends the sound.
seeds.年: A person 卩 hauls home the grain 禾 harvest — one harvest, one trip around the sun: a year.
seeds.八: Two strokes leaning away from each other, splitting apart — borrowed long ago to write the number eight.
seeds.饭: The food 饣 radical on your plate — a hot meal of rice. 反 fǎn lends the sound.
seeds.今: A mouth mid-breath, sound just leaving it — the instant of speaking is now, today.
seeds.您: 你 you set gently on a heart 心 — addressing someone with your whole heart is the polite you. 你 nǐ lends the sound.
seeds.爸: Your father 父 with a small child 巴 clinging to his leg — that's dad. 巴 bā lends the sound.
seeds.房: Behind the door 戶 lies the room, the house itself. 方 fāng lends the sound.
seeds.九: A single bent stroke like an arm crooked at the elbow, hand reaching to grab — stretching for the last number before ten: nine.
seeds.牛: The head of a cow seen straight on — the vertical its face, the top strokes its horns.
seeds.吧: A mouth 口 with a small child 巴 clinging to the sentence's end — the soft tag that turns it into a suggestion: ...OK? 巴 bā lends the sound.
seeds.飞: A bird caught mid-flap — the hooked stroke its body, the two flicks its beating wings: to fly.
seeds.觉: Under the studying top of 学 learn sits an eye 见 seeing — what you see and take in is what you feel and perceive. 学 xué echoes the sound.
seeds.女: A stick figure squatting with arms crossed, breasts marked — the ancient picture of a woman.
seeds.白: A ray of light striking down into a bright disc — glare on the page, snow at noon: white.
seeds.非: Two wings splayed in opposite directions — pulling apart, never matching: not, wrong.
seeds.开: Two hands 廾 lift the crossbar ◎ off a gate — the bolt slides free and the door swings open.
seeds.朋: Two matched strings of cowries hung side by side — a perfect pair, like you and your friend. (It looks like two moons 月, but it's the pair that counts.)
seeds.百: One 一 stroke capping 白 white — one white abacus row filled to the top: a hundred. 白 bái lends the sound.
seeds.分: A knife 刀 slicing between two halves 八 splitting apart — to divide and hand out the pieces.
seeds.看: A hand 手 shading the eyes 目 as you squint into the distance — to look, to watch.
seeds.漂: Something graceful gliding on 氵 water, smooth and polished as it drifts — elegant. 票 piào lends the sound.
seeds.班: A knife 刂 splits a pair of gems 玨 into matched halves — dividing people the same way gives you teams and classes.
seeds.服: A kneeling person 卩 and a serving hand 又 by a table ◎ — being dressed and served: clothes, and the service that brings them.
seeds.可: A mouth 口 beside an old axe-handle shape ◎ — the mouth grants permission with a single word: you can, you may.
seeds.苹: Grass 艹 lying flat 平 on a pond — duckweed, the little floating plant (and the 苹 in apple). 平 píng lends the sound.
seeds.半: A cow 牛 split down the middle by 八 dividing strokes — one clean cut, two equal halves: half.
seeds.高: A watchtower in profile — roof on top, tall body, gate at the base — the tallest building in town: high.
seeds.客: Someone arrives under your roof 宀 — a visitor settling in as your guest. 各 gè echoes the sound.
seeds.七: An old cross-shaped mark for a cut across a line — the cut borrowed its shape for the number seven.
seeds.包: An unborn baby curled inside the curve of its mother's body — wrapped up and held: to wrap, to contain.
seeds.哥: 可 stacked on 可 — the one who got everything twice over, born first: elder brother. 可 kě lends the sound.
seeds.课: Speech 讠 delivered on schedule — the teacher talking through today's lesson: a class, a course.
seeds.期: The moon 月 keeping its steady schedule — one full cycle marks a period of time. 其 qí lends the sound.
seeds.杯: A cup carved from wood 木 — the old drinking vessel before glass and porcelain.
seeds.歌: An open mouth 欠 yawning wide beside 哥 big brother — he throws his head back and belts out a song. 哥 gē lends the sound.
seeds.口: A simple open square — the picture of a mouth.
seeds.起: You walk 走 and lift your own self 己 off the ground — to rise, to get up. 己 jǐ echoes the sound.
seeds.本: A tree 木 with an extra bar ◎ marking its base — pointing right at the roots: root, origin.
seeds.个: A single stalk of bamboo — one lone item, the all-purpose measure word for one of anything.
seeds.块: Earth 土 broken off in one decisive chunk — a lump, a piece. 夬 guài lends the sound.
seeds.气: Three wavy strokes of rising vapor — steam curling off a pot: gas, air.
seeds.边: Walking 辶 with all your strength 力 until the ground runs out — you've reached the side, the edge.
seeds.给: A silk 纟 thread handed over as a joined 合 gift — precious cloth passed to someone: to give. 合 gě lends the sound.
seeds.来: A stalk of wheat, ears drooping from the stem — the harvest wagon is coming; the wheat picture was borrowed for 'to come'.
seeds.千: A person 亻 balanced on the stroke of one 一 — one person tallied a thousand times over.
seeds.便: A person 亻 shifts to change 更 into an easier position — whatever is comfortable and convenient.
seeds.工: A carpenter's square, top beam and base joined by one upright — the tool that stands for work and craft.
seeds.老: An elder bent over a cane, long hair trailing down the strokes — the picture of old age.
seeds.前: A boat 舟 with a foot 止 on deck pressing onward — the boat glides forward, ahead.
seeds.病: The sickness 疒 radical is a person laid flat on a bed — down with illness. 丙 bǐng lends the sound.
seeds.公: Once a picture of a shared liquid vessel — everyone drinks from the common pot: public, belonging to all.
seeds.了: A child like 子 but with the arms cut short — the action cut short, finished: the done-marker 了.
seeds.钱: Metal 金 hammered into narrow 戔 slivers — thin coins clinking in your palm: money. 戔 jiān echoes the sound.
seeds.不: The sepals of a flower closing tight, refusing to open — the flower picture was borrowed for a flat no.
seeds.狗: The dog 犭 radical with a hooked 句 tail curling behind — a dog. 句 gōu lends the sound.
seeds.冷: Ice 冫 crystals delivered by decree — a command 令 to shiver: cold. 令 lìng lends the sound.
seeds.请: Speech 讠 offered fresh and green as 青 spring grass — polite words that ask and invite: please. 青 qīng lends the sound.
seeds.菜: Under 艹 grass, a hand 采 picks and gathers greens — what you pluck from the garden becomes the dish on the table. 采 cǎi lends the sound.
seeds.关: The old form put a bar across a 門 gate; simplification stripped the gate away, leaving just the bolt 关 that shuts everything off.
seeds.里: A 田 field sitting on 土 earth — where fields meet worked ground, a village grows. In simplified script that village square also means inside.
seeds.去: A big 大 figure striding away from a 口 opening — a person leaving the cave mouth behind is going.
seeds.茶: 艹 grass on top marks the leafy plant whose leaves you steep — tea, the herb below the grass roof.
seeds.贵: Two hands hoist a 贝 shell overhead — shells were ancient money, so whatever needs both hands to carry its price is expensive.
seeds.两: One frame with two identical figures standing side by side inside — a matched pair, both of them: two.
seeds.热: A hand 执 grasping something held right over 灬 fire — you can only grip it a second, it is that hot.
seeds.常: A 巾 cloth banner you value 尚 enough to fly every single day — what hangs there constantly is the ordinary, the always. 尚 shàng lends the sound.
seeds.国: Inside the 囗 walls sits the 玉 jade treasure — a border drawn around what the realm guards is a country.
seeds.亮: A 人 person climbs to the highest tower in 京 the capital and catches the first light — up there everything is bright.
seeds.人: Two strokes leaning together — the side view of a person mid-stride, legs planted.
seeds.唱: A 口 mouth pouring out something 昌 flourishing — a voice in full bloom is singing. 昌 chāng lends the sound.
seeds.果: A 木 tree with a round mass ripening at its crown — fruit hanging where the branches meet.
seeds.零: 雨 rain issued like an 令 order — drops falling one by one until nothing is left: scattered fragments, then zero. 令 líng lends the sound.
seeds.认: 讠 speech meeting a 人 person — you say their name aloud because you recognize them. 人 rén lends the sound.
seeds.超: 走 walking legs answering a 召 summons — you break into a leap and clear whoever is ahead, surpassing them. 召 zhào hints the sound.
seeds.还: 辶 walking back down the road you said 不 no to — turning around means you still return, and the trip is still going.
seeds.六: Originally a little tent — a roof stroke over two legs. Borrowed long ago for the number six; count the tent as bunk number 6.
seeds.日: A square sun with a dot at its center — the circle squared off by the carver's knife: sun, and the day it measures.
seeds.车: A chariot seen from above, axle through the body — the old wheel-and-cart drawing streamlined into today's car.
seeds.孩: A 子 child small enough to be counted on the zodiac's last branch 亥 — the little one of the family. 亥 hài lends the sound.
seeds.妈: A 女 woman with a 马 horse at her side — mom, hauling the whole family along tirelessly. 马 mǎ lends the sound.
seeds.三: Three horizontal strokes stacked like three rungs — the number three, drawn as plainly as tally marks.
seeds.吃: A 口 mouth beside a beggar 乞 asking for food — what the mouth does the moment the bowl arrives: eat.
seeds.汉: 氵 water names the Han river; the 又 hand is all that's left of the old right side. From that river came the Han people and their characters.
seeds.吗: A 口 mouth with a 马 horse galloping out of it — the little snort tacked on the end of a sentence that turns it into a question. 马 mǎ lends the sound.
seeds.商: Under a 辛 hard-labor roof, a 口 mouth haggles all day — talking is the merchant's toil, and commerce is the result.
seeds.出: A 止 foot stepping up out of a pit, drawn twice for the climb — going out, one step over the rim.
seeds.好: A woman 女 with her child 子 — the classic picture of what is good.
seeds.买: A 网 net scooping up goods with a 头 head poking underneath to inspect them — bagging what you want is buying.
seeds.上: A short stroke floating above the base line, with a post to prop it — the mark that simply points up.
seeds.穿: A 牙 tooth gnawing through the wall of a 穴 cave — piercing through. Clothes are what your head and arms pierce through to put on.
seeds.号: A 口 mouth pushing out a long 丂 breath — a cry, a call sign, and eventually the number you're called by.
seeds.卖: Take what you 买 bought and send it 出 out the door again — goods going out is selling. 买 mǎi lends the sound.
seeds.少: 小 small with one grain flicking away — sand slipping through fingers, a few dots getting fewer.
seeds.床: A plank of 木 wood pushed under the 广 roof-slope — the wooden frame you sleep on: a bed.
seeds.喝: A 口 mouth tipped back asking 曷 why is it already empty — glug it down, drink. 曷 hé lends the sound.
seeds.忙: Your 忄 heart feels like it's 亡 fleeing — racing off without you. That runaway-heart feeling is being busy.
seeds.谁: 讠 speech chasing a 隹 bird — you call after it, but which bird answered? Who? 隹 zhuī hints the sound (shéi/shuí).
seeds.打: A 扌 hand swinging at a 丁 nail — the strike of hammer on nail head: to hit.
seeds.和: 禾 grain shared and a 口 mouth fed — full bellies all around make harmony, the glue of and, together. 禾 hé lends the sound.
seeds.猫: A 犭 beast crouched in the 苗 sprouts, guarding the seedlings from mice — the cat on field patrol. 苗 miáo lends the sound.
seeds.什: A 亻 person assigned to a squad of 十 ten soldiers — the old headcount word, later borrowed for what.
seeds.大: A person standing with arms flung wide — showing you just how big it was.
seeds.很: 彳 walking on and on with a 艮 blunt, stubborn stride — pushing the pace hard: very.
seeds.么: A tiny curl of thread, the smallest wisp — so light it became the weightless particle at the end of 什么.
seeds.生: A sprout pushing up out of the ground line — life emerging, being born.
seeds.蛋: A 虫 creature's life 延 prolonged inside a shell — the little animal waiting in its oval capsule: an egg.
seeds.后: Once the empress — mirror twin of 司, the one giving orders. The ruler walks first; simplified script keeps her for what comes after, behind.
seeds.没: A 又 hand plunging into 氵 water after something that swirls away — it sank, it's gone: have not.
seeds.师: A 刂 blade beside 帀 everywhere-encircling ranks — the drillmaster the whole camp circles around: the master, the teacher.
seeds.到: 至 arrive with a 刂 knife stuck in beside it — the blade pinned at the exact spot you reached: arrived, up to here. 刂 dāo lends the sound.
seeds.候: A 亻 person standing by the 矦 archery target, watching for the next arrow — waiting, attending, keeping watch. 矦 hóu lends the sound.
seeds.妹: A 女 girl who is 未 not yet grown — the one still catching up: younger sister.
seeds.十: One vertical stroke crossing one horizontal — a full bundle tallied and tied off: ten.
seeds.道: 辶 walking with your 首 head leading the way — the path your head chooses and your feet follow: the way.
seeds.话: 言 speech shaped by the 舌 tongue — the tongue working words into talk, a spoken language.
seeds.们: 亻 people filing through one 门 gate together — a crowd through the doorway makes the plural. 门 mén lends the sound.
seeds.时: The 日 sun measured off by a 寸 thumb-width — the sun's position marked hand over hand: time.
seeds.得: On the road 彳 walk, a hand 寸 closes around a cowrie shell 貝 — ancient money found on the path. Grabbing cash mid-stride is obtaining.
seeds.欢: 欠 is a person with mouth wide open — here laughing, head thrown back — while a hand 又 slaps a knee. Pure joy.
seeds.米: Grains of rice scattered around a cross-shaped stalk — the pictograph of rice itself.
seeds.识: Speech 讠 that pins a thing down as only 只 this, nothing else — naming it exactly is knowing it.
seeds.的: White 白 sunlight glinting off a polished spoon 勺 — originally 'bright white', later borrowed for the everywhere-particle 'of'.
seeds.回: A spiral drawn as a square within a square — the path curls back on itself, so you circle around and return.
seeds.面: The outline of a head with a single eye 目 staring out of it — a face, the surface you show the world.
seeds.士: The head of a battle-axe standing upright — the badge of the officer, later the scholar-gentleman.
seeds.弟: A cord wound in loops down a dagger-axe 戈 shaft — the little one who trails after you in order, the younger brother.
seeds.会: A roof over gathered people (from 合, together) — where people can come together, things can get done: to be able, to meet.
seeds.名: At dusk 夕 no one can see your face, so your mouth 口 must speak up — announcing yourself in the dark is your name.
seeds.市: Under a banner, the bustle and cries 兮 of stalls — the noisy hubbub of a market town. 之 zhī loosely lends the sound.
seeds.第: Bamboo ⺮ slips strung in sequence, one after another like siblings — ranked order. 弟 dì lends the sound.
seeds.火: A blaze with flames leaping up and sparks flying out to both sides — fire itself.
seeds.明: The moon 月 pouring light through a window 囧 at night — that glow is brightness.
seeds.事: A hand 又 gripping a clerk's tally-stick, held straight through the day's business — the matters and affairs of work.
seeds.点: A diviner 占 watches sparks: tiny fire 灬 droplets spitting off the flames — each spark a dot, a point.
seeds.机: A plank of wood 木 fitted onto a small table 几 frame — the loom, the first machine. 几 jī lends the sound.
seeds.哪: A mouth 口 pointing at 那 that one, then that one — asking which? 那 nà lends the sound.
seeds.视: An altar sign 礻 you turn to see 见 — looking closely at what is revealed. 礻 shì lends the sound.
seeds.电: A lightning bolt zig-zagging down from the sky, its tail whipping out — raw electricity.
seeds.鸡: A hand 又 reaching for a bird 鸟 that squawks and flaps around the yard — the chicken you have to catch for dinner.
seeds.那: A city ⻏ off in the distance, its banners drooping 冄 on the horizon — you point: that one, over there.
seeds.是: The dawn sun 旦 with a foot 龰 planted under it — standing firmly on what the daylight shows: yes, it is so.
seeds.东: A bundle tied at both ends, slung over a shoulder at first light — you march toward the sunrise: east. The meaning is a phonetic loan.
seeds.几: A small low table on two slim legs. Later borrowed to ask 'how many?' — count the things piled on the little table.
seeds.奶: A woman 女 nursing — milk, the breast. 乃 nǎi lends the sound.
seeds.手: An open hand, five fingers spread from the wrist — the hand itself.
seeds.都: Every -er, everyone 者 crowds into the capital city ⻏ — the whole lot of them, all.
seeds.家: A pig 豕 under a roof 宀 — the old farmhouse with livestock inside is home and family.
seeds.男: Muscle 力 straining behind a plow in the field 田 — the field-worker, the male.
seeds.书: A hand gripping a writing brush 聿, ink trailing down the page — writing, a book.
seeds.读: Speech 讠 performed like a street-seller 卖 hawking wares — chanting the text aloud, reading.
seeds.间: Sunlight 日 slipping through the crack in a double door 门 — the gap, the space between.
seeds.脑: Flesh ⺼ packed under the soft crown of the skull 囟 — the brain in its case.
seeds.水: A flowing river: the central current with droplets splashing along both banks — water.
seeds.对: A hand 又 lines the tool up by exact thumb-widths 寸 — everything squared and matched: correct, a pair.
seeds.见: A person 卩 who is all eye 目 — one giant eyeball on legs, walking around seeing everything.
seeds.呢: A mouth 口 sound with no meaning of its own, borrowed from 尼 — the little tag you add: '...and you?' 尼 ní lends the sound.
seeds.睡: The eyelids 目 hang down and droop 垂 — eyes drooping shut is sleep. 垂 chuí hints at the sound.
seeds.多: Two identical shapes stacked, one on the other, and you could keep stacking — more and more: many.
seeds.件: A person 亻 tallying a herd cow 牛 by cow — counting things one item at a time.
seeds.能: A bear in profile, meat ⺼ in its jaws, paws at the ready — nothing a bear can't do. Originally 'bear', now 'able'.
seeds.说: Words 讠 exchanged 兑 back and forth like coins across a counter — speaking, explaining.
seeds.儿: A toddler on two little legs, the top of its head still open at the soft spot — a child.
seeds.叫: A mouth 口 pulling on a tangled rope 丩, hauling someone in with a yell — to shout, to call.
seeds.你: A person 亻 marked with 尔, the archaic word for 'you' — the you standing in front of me.
seeds.司: A mouth barking orders under an official's raised hand — the one in charge, managing the department.
seeds.四: A box divided by two legs inside — four walls, four corners. Count the enclosed sections and edges: four.
seeds.西: A bird settling into its nest as the sun sinks — birds roost where the sun sets: the west.
seeds.样: A carpenter carves a wooden 木 template shaped like a sheep 羊 — the pattern every copy follows. 羊 yáng lends the sound.
seeds.怎: The heart 心 stops mid-task 作 and asks — how? how on earth do I do this?
seeds.岁: A mountain 山 with dusk 夕 falling on it — each sunset behind the peaks tallies another year of age.
seeds.息: Air drawn through the nose 自 down to the heart 心 — one full breath; later, the 'news' you catch your breath over.
seeds.要: Two hands 覀 clasping a woman's 女 waist — originally 'waist'; what you wrap your arms around is what you want.
seeds.找: A hand 扌 sweeping a dagger-axe 戈 through the grass, parting it blade by blade — hunting for what's lost.
seeds.他: A person 亻 who is also 也 there, off to the side — that other one: he, him.
seeds.习: A single wing 羽 flapping again and again over the nest edge — the fledgling drilling flight until it's habit.
seeds.也: A curling snake-like squiggle, borrowed long ago for 'also' — the little tail that says 'me too'.
seeds.这: Walking 辶 up to a piece of writing 文 close enough to read it — the one right here: this.
seeds.它: Originally a coiled snake — the curve its body, the hook its tail. The snake slithered off to become 蛇, leaving this shape behind as the pronoun for 'it'.
seeds.喜: A drum 壴 booming while a mouth 口 sings along below — a whole party in one character. What you beat drums and sing for is what you like and enjoy.
seeds.一: A single horizontal stroke: one finger laid flat on the table, counting one.
seeds.真: A shell 貝 (ancient money) tested with a spoon 匕 — tap it, weigh it, prove it's the real thing. Only what survives inspection is true.
seeds.她: A woman 女 on the left marks this as the female pronoun — same word as 它/他, but the 女 tells you it's she.
seeds.系: A hand 又 gripping a bundle of silk threads 糸, holding all the strands tied into one — connecting, tying together.
seeds.衣: A coat seen head-on: the top a collar, the sweeping sides two lapels folding over each other. Clothes.
seeds.正: A foot 止 marching dead ahead toward the line above it — no wandering, no detours. Perfectly straight and proper.
seeds.太: 大 big with one extra dot squeezed underneath — big, plus a little more than big. That's too much, the greatest.
seeds.下: A short stroke hanging below the long baseline, pointing down — the mirror of 上.
seeds.医: An arrow of sickness caught in an open box — the doctor's case where the ailment gets pulled out and sealed away. Medicine. 殹 yì lent the sound in the old form.
seeds.知: An arrow 矢 beside a mouth 口 — knowledge flies from the speaker's mouth straight and fast as an arrow. To know.
seeds.题: A head 頁 bent over the exam paper, staring at the question. 是 shì sits inside as the old sound element for tí.
seeds.先: A person 人 with a foot 止 planted on top of their head — someone's foot already ahead of everyone else. First, earlier, before.
seeds.宜: Two slabs of meat ⺼ laid neatly on the offering table — everything arranged just as it should be. Fitting, proper, suitable.
seeds.只: A mouth 口 with two legs walking away — one lone mouth to feed, nothing else. Only, merely.
seeds.天: A line drawn across the top of a big person 大 — the ceiling above the tallest human is the sky, and one turn of it is a day.
seeds.现: Jade 𤣩 polished until it flashes into view — the gleam appearing right now, before your eyes. 見 xiàn lends the sound.
seeds.以: A person 人 picks up the curled tool on the left and puts it to work — to use, by means of.
seeds.中: A flagpole line driven straight through the middle of a box — dead center, within.
seeds.条: A tree 木 with a foot 夂 stepping down it — strip a long thin branch off the trunk and you have one 条: a strip, an item.
seeds.想: 相 (an eye 目 inspecting a tree 木) sits on your heart 心 — the heart inspecting images is thinking. 相 xiāng lends the sound.
seeds.椅: Wood 木 built into something strange 奇 — a wooden contraption you sit on with legs like a beast: a chair.
seeds.钟: Metal 钅 struck dead in the middle 中 — the bell that tolls the hour. A clock. 中 zhōng lends the sound.
seeds.听: A mouth 口 speaking toward the great hall 厅, where every word echoes to the listeners — to listen. 厅 tīng lends the sound.
seeds.小: Three tiny grains of sand scattering apart — a hook and two dots, each smaller than the last. Small.
seeds.影: Bright scenery 景 casting fine streaks 彡 behind it — the hair-thin lines are the shadow, the image it throws.
seeds.住: A person 亻 beside the master 主 of the house — you stay and live where your host is. 主 zhǔ lends the sound.
seeds.同: An upside-down bucket with a mouth 口 inside — everyone drinking from the same tub, saying the same word. Same, together.
seeds.校: Wood 木 where paths cross 交 — a timber building where young lives intersect: the school.
seeds.友: Two right hands 又 clasped over each other — the oldest handshake in writing. A friend.
seeds.桌: Wood 木 crafted into something outstanding 卓 — the one wooden surface everything in the room gathers around: the table. 卓 zhuō lends the sound.
seeds.外: A diviner's crack 卜 read outside the city gate at moonrise 月 — omens are taken outdoors. Outside.
seeds.些: Take this 此 and add two 二 more — this one, plus a couple: some, a few.
seeds.有: A hand 又 clutching a slab of meat ⺼ — to hold something is to have it.
seeds.子: A baby with both arms flung wide, its legs still swaddled into one stroke below. A child, a son.
seeds.玩: Turning a piece of jade 𤣩 over and over in your hands just for the pleasure of it — to play. 元 lends the sound.
seeds.写: Under a roof 冖 a hand loops and drags 与 across the page — indoors, where writing gets done.
seeds.雨: Rain caught mid-fall: the top bar a cloud, four drops streaking down inside the frame.
seeds.字: A child 子 raised under the family roof 宀 — characters too are 'raised' one by one until they grow into words. 子 zǐ lends the sound.
seeds.晚: The sun 日 finally exempted 免 from duty, let off work for the day — evening, late.
seeds.谢: Words 讠 shot 射 straight back at the giver like a return arrow — thanks fired off the moment the gift lands.
seeds.语: Speech 讠 plus the old word for 'I' 吾 — the words I speak: my language, my tongue.
seeds.租: Grain 禾 stacked up 且 like layered shelves and handed to the landlord — the old land tax, now the rent you pay.
seeds.喂: A mouth 口 shouted at something fearsome 畏 — 'hey!' — and the same mouth coaxing food into it: to feed. 畏 wèi lends the sound.
seeds.新: An axe 斤 biting into fresh wood 木, exposing pale timber no one has ever seen — brand new. 辛 xīn lends the sound.
seeds.元: A person with two strokes stacked above marking the head — the topmost part, hence first, primary, and the name of the top currency unit.
seeds.昨: The sun 日 that abruptly 乍 got mowed down — the day already cut and gone: yesterday.

seeds.胖: Flesh ⺼ at half 半 again the usual amount — a plump, well-fed frame.

seeds.担: A hand 扌 hoisting the load at dawn 旦 — shouldering the day's burden first thing. 旦 dàn lends the sound.
